title: Length spectrum of periodic rays for billard flow
summary: We study for several compact strictly convex disjoint obstacles the length spectrum $\mathcal L$ formed by the lengths of all primitive periodic reflecting rays. We prove the existence of sequences $\{\ell_j\},\: \{m_j\}$ with $\ell_j \in \mathcal L,\: m_j \in \mathbb N$ such that the condition (LB) related to the dynamical zeta function $η_D(s)$ is satisfied. This condition implies the existence of lower bounds for the number of the scattering resonances for Dirichlet Laplacian.
